{{Quote|Just another day on the Inte'kepta Way. The Royal Security Forces seem to be more.. forceful lately. Unfortunately, Squad 56-TY was unable to successfully "secure" any freighters or civilian speeders today.|[[Bven Ji'ontha]]|<ref name="SWG:aIR" />}}
The '''Inte'kepta Way''' was a space lane in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was frequently raided by [[Borvo]] the Hutt's [[Squad 56-TY]].<ref name="SWG:aIR">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|an Inventory Report}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Inte'kepta Way was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:aIR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mention of the Inte'kepta Way was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:aIR" />
